shape.text: A SendGrid API key is always 69 characters long in total and is never issued shorter.

Scanner rules read a key as the prefix SG., a 22-character identifier segment, a dot, and a 43-character secret segment drawn from letters, digits, underscore and hyphen. The support article does not state the prefix, the split or the alphabet.

issuance.text: Full-access and restricted-access API keys share one format.

unresolved.reason: Recorded in a research note without a cited source; the cited support article addresses key length only.

openQuestions.text: Is the 22 and 43 character split, with its alphabet, a documented property of the key?

unresolved.reason: No SendGrid page states the 22 and 43 character split or the alphabet; only scanner rules do, and no issued key was inspected.
